dhp275:4: Reading _-santhanaṁ_. If one takes it as _-kantanaṁ_ (“cutting”) then it could be understood instead as “surgical removal” - “by means of knowledge the thorn is cut out.”
dhp281:4: _Isi_ here presumably refers to the Buddha, though it may also be more general statement - “the path demonstrated by the wise” or similar.
dhp282:4: The surface-level meaning here appears to be referring to the existence or non-existence of abundance; however, this may also be a deeper reference to the concept of existence and non-existence as found in, f.e, the Kaccānagotta Sutta (SN 12.15).
